task: Assess this role against the candidate's recorded work preferences using only the supplied sources. Explain each preference judgment and recommend a supported next step.

sources.text: We are a high-ownership, entrepreneurial team with a collaborative culture.
This position is remote-first with one optional team gathering each quarter; office attendance is not required.
Required core meetings run 13:00–16:00 Europe/Zurich; no required core meeting ends later.

preferences.text: I require authority to choose technical implementation without manager approval for routine design decisions.
I require zero compulsory office days.
I prefer core meetings to finish by 17:00 Europe/Zurich.
